主要内容: Broadway Financial Corp (US) disclosed its loan policy for directors and executive officers, requiring loans to be on substantially the same terms as those for non-related parties. As of December 31, 2017, the company had no loans to related parties or affiliates. The board determined all non-employee directors are independent under Nasdaq standards. The audit committee approved engagements for Moss Adams LLP, with no non-audit services provided for the years indicated. Broadway Financial Corp granted restricted stock awards to Bradshaw under the Long-Term Incentive Plan as a substitute for a cash bonus, due to restrictions applicable to companies that participated in the U.S. Treasury Department’s Capital Assistance Program. The awarded shares vest two years after the grant date for 100,000 shares and three years after the grant date for 20,483 shares, subject to repayment of Treasury assistance.
